name: Blended Learning
description: Combines instructor-led and online training within SuccessFactors LMS.
benefits: Provides flexible learning paths that blend different delivery formats.
leverage: Use to deliver mixed-mode training programs and track progress comprehensively.
user_experience: Learners see both ILT and online components within a single item.
tips: Schedule ILT sessions in advance and include pre-work online modules.

name: Machine Learning Recommendations
description: AI-based course recommendations tailored to learner profile and history.
benefits: Increases engagement by suggesting relevant content.
leverage: Enable to let system propose courses based on user behavior.
user_experience: Learners see personalized recommendations on their homepage.
tips: Ensure sufficient historical data for better predictions.

name: Skills Assessment
description: Allows assessment of learner skills and gap analysis.
benefits: Helps align training with skill gaps and organizational needs.
leverage: Use to measure skill proficiency and plan targeted learning.
user_experience: Learners complete skill assessments and view results.
tips: Combine with curricula to address identified gaps.
